meta.title: E08 · Countermeasure ablation on the modern battlefield
meta.description: On the 2024-26 threat world (fibre 30%, low-rate 30%, 2 decoys), with a filter→LNA front end fixed, turn on one DSP countermeasure at a time. Isolates what each buys when the hard new threats are present — cyclostationary should dominate because of the low-rate links.
